title: James P NDE 20664
content:
After the surgery for a traumatic brain injury, the doctors put me into a coma for a couple weeks to help give my body time to heal. During this time, I thought I woke up to see the person in the bed to my right die. After I recovered, and started to ask questions about his death, and the doctors and nurses insisted that I could not possibly have remembered this. It seems as though I was standing beside my bed looking over top of myself towards the person in the next bed down from me. The nurses all of a sudden came to his bed in a hurry. The first one there tried frantically to recover him, but it didn't work. Many other nurses surrounded his bed and did a lot of stuff to him as well, but he died. When this happened, I can remember seeing some sort of fog, or cloud come directly up from his body and leave the room. I knew right at that time he had died, because of what it felt like. I could not hear any sounds during this event, but I can still remember all of the feelings. The nurses had a distraught anxious feeling during this time. The older nurse seemed to be consoling the other nurses, by that I mean she seemed to give the other nurses the idea that this happens in the intensive care unit, but we are here to save the ones we can. This event has changed my life. I think it taught me how to FEEL more than I ever had before.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' After an accident, I ended up with severe Traumatic Brain Injury. I had to undergo Brain surgery to repair some damaged areas.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Strong emotional tone | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was over the top of my body looking down.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: There were no sounds. Only feelings.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The hospital staff, and the man who died.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I could only see what happened, and feel the emotions in the room.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Mostly confusion, but then there was sorrow for the other man.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Only by seeing the cloud of fog leaving his body. I'm guessing that this was a spirit of a person going to wherever it was supposed to.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I believe now, without a doubt, there is something after death. I just don't know where, or what it is.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It's hard to believe that I can remember anything during a coma.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes It seems that I have the ability to know what other people want, or are feeling now. I have not experimented with it though. I just let life go on as it should.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was to have the proof of the after events of death. The worst part of the experience was that someone had died.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Mostly the few people I share this with seem to doubt me. Probably because they know how bad of shape I was in at the time. I, however, know what is real and what is not.
